Master’s degree in Nursing (MSN or MS)
2 years of nursing leadership experience in a Home Infusion, Home Health, or Infusion Clinic setting

The Home Infusion Nurse Manager is responsible for the daily hour planning, organizing, directing and controlling of the daily operations and clinical practice of assigned patient care areas, in order to provide quality, individualized patient care and support of UC Davis Health philosophies. The Home Infusion Nurse Manager will lead staff to model a professional practice environment by: providing a clinically competent staff; encouraging strong interdisciplinary team collaboration and communication; supporting autonomy and accountability; providing staff opportunities for in-service and formal education; stressing the importance of continuous learning; and supporting a culture where concern for the patient is paramount. The Home Infusion Nurse Manager assumes fiscal responsibility through preparation of unit budgets, supports research, participates in both long and short term strategic planning, and assures patient advocacy. The Home Infusion Nurse Manager is accountable to the Assistant Chief Pharmacy Officer, Home Infusion and the Ambulatory Chief Nursing Executive.
